dedupe_keys.name: inamhi ecuador meteorological and hydrological yearbooks isohyets and hazard maps

description: The library of the National Institute of Meteorology and Hydrology of Ecuador (INAMHI) offers downloads of its station data publications and maps. It holds the meteorological yearbooks for each year from 1971 to 2013 and the hydrological yearbooks from the late 1990s to 2013, plus a hydrological yearbook for 2014 to 2016 from automatic stations, a meteorological glossary, and maps including a flood hazard map of the upper Chone river basin (2008), a map of the climates of Ecuador (2006) and the hydrogeology of the Guayas basin (2003). Rainfall isohyets for 1985 to 2015 are available as TIF, SHP, PDF and JPG. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the yearbooks are published documents and the series stop in the mid-2010s, and the institute's geoinformation page read on the same day showed unrelated spam content instead of its data listing. Coverage is Ecuador. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis of rainfall, floods and drought for roads, dams, water supply and energy infrastructure, and long-term hydrological baselines; related records are the IMN Costa Rica climate atlas and stations and the INDOMET Dominican climate data.
